title: Fischl: Phantasmal Nocturne
desc: "Still, while every question is unexpected, some are definitely more unexpected than others. For instance, one little witch might be asked to use the primordial light to create her own material world. Meanwhile, another might be told to grant a 'soul' to a being that only exists in the imagination."
